attributes.name: face_to_face
attributes.text: The two people stand facing each other.
attributes.definition: The front of each torso points toward the other person for most of the action.

attributes.name: side_by_side_or_behind
attributes.text: One person stands beside or behind the other.
attributes.definition: The actor is at the side of or behind the partner, so the partner's torso does not face the actor.

attributes.name: hands_meet_between
attributes.text: A hand of each person meets in the space between them.
attributes.definition: Both people extend a hand forward and the two hands touch or nearly touch at a point midway between their bodies.

attributes.name: hit_partner_body
attributes.text: One person's hand or foot hits the other's body quickly.
attributes.definition: A fast-moving hand, arm or foot of the actor reaches the partner's head, torso or legs and stops there briefly.

attributes.name: partner_recoils
attributes.text: The partner's body jerks or steps back away from the actor.
attributes.definition: The partner's head or torso moves suddenly away from the actor, or the partner steps backward, in response to the actor's movement.

attributes.name: partner_raises_arms_to_block
attributes.text: The partner lifts the arms in front of the head or body.
attributes.definition: The partner's hands rise quickly to in front of the face or chest, or up beside the head, in response to the actor.

attributes.name: arm_aimed_without_contact
attributes.text: The actor aims an arm or hands at the partner without touching.
attributes.definition: The actor holds an arm or both hands directed at the partner from a distance, with no contact between their bodies.

attributes.name: distance_shrinks
attributes.text: The two people move closer together.
attributes.definition: The distance between the two torsos decreases clearly over the clip because one or both move toward the other.

attributes.name: distance_grows
attributes.text: The two people end farther apart than they started.
attributes.definition: The distance between the two torsos increases clearly over the clip.

attributes.name: prolonged_body_contact
attributes.text: The two bodies stay in contact for a long time.
attributes.definition: Arms or torsos of the two people stay touching for most of the clip, not just a brief touch.

attributes.name: travel_together
attributes.text: Both people walk in the same direction.
attributes.definition: Both people take steps and their bodies move across the floor in the same direction at a similar pace.

attributes.name: both_do_same_motion
attributes.text: Both people make the same movement at the same time.
attributes.definition: The two skeletons perform matching movements together rather than one acting and the other reacting.

attributes.name: partner_stays_passive
attributes.text: One person acts while the other stands mostly still.
attributes.definition: Only the actor makes a clear movement; the partner's joints barely move and show no strong reaction.
